notes: Build100 adds an explicit Lovable Publish / Deployment Adapter using only the official https://mcp.lovable.dev MCP provider contract and deploy_project tool. Preflight locks get_project/deploy_project to the exact Lovable project_id, requires the currently observed Lovable commit to match the canonical Git HEAD when available, and enforces Build98 DEPLOY=ALWAYS_ASK. Each publish uses a one-time MCP write approval, a separate Continuity task with deploy-write retrySafe=false/maxAttempts=1, sanitized Change Transaction metadata and Operation Journal evidence. Any post-write uncertainty becomes verification_required and never triggers deploy_project automatically again. Raw MCP results/tokens are not durably persisted. No private Lovable REST publish endpoint or provider rollback/unpublish capability is invented; redeploy requires a fresh prepare plus explicit human approval. This package metadata does not authorize OTA, GitHub Release, store publication or merge to main.
